summary: The zero-axiom PTQ core, the trunk of the Montague lineage: IL types shallowly with intension/extension over an abstract Index; term phrases as generalized quantifiers with type raising (star); the determiners every/a/no and the fragment sentences; quantifying-in with both scopes of 'every man loves a woman' (inverse entails surface; the readings proved genuinely distinct by a bool countermodel); the seek/find contrast — intensional verbs take quantifier objects, de dicto seek carries no existential commitment (axiom-free existence countermodel), lifted verbs collapse de dicto/de re (the meaning-postulate shape), de re always commits; Barwise-Cooper hooks (conservativity and monotonicity of the PTQ determiners); the minimal modal layer (box with K, T, Nec) for the Kratzer edge.
